verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a feature that exports all user data in open formats. The closest items are only adjacent: self-hosting for data control, local client-side storage by default, raw-Markdown editing of Agent profiles, a 'Migrate from Local Database' doc link, and a REST API/OpenAPI spec, which is a developer building block rather than an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
